title: Glowing motorbike
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='60%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#00ffcc' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#00ffcc' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='46' ry='30' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='23' cy='70' r='13' fill='#1a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='23' cy='70' r='8' fill='#00e6b0'/>
  <circle cx='23' cy='70' r='3' fill='#0a1420'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='70' r='13' fill='#1a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='70' r='8' fill='#00e6b0'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='70' r='3' fill='#0a1420'/>
  <!-- spokes -->
  <g stroke='#0a1420' stroke-width='1.5'>
    <line x1='23' y1='62' x2='23' y2='78'/>
    <line x1='15' y1='70' x2='31' y2='70'/>
    <line x1='77' y1='62' x2='77' y2='78'/>
    <line x1='69' y1='70' x2='85' y2='70'/>
  </g>
  <!-- frame body -->
  <path d='M23 70 L38 58 L52 52 L68 56 L77 70' stroke='#ff4fa0' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- fuel tank / seat -->
  <path d='M38 58 L52 52 L60 55 L54 62 Z' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <rect x='52' y='49' width='16' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ff8a3d'/>
  <!-- engine block -->
  <rect x='40' y='62' width='18' height='12' rx='3' fill='#7ce0ff'/>
  <rect x='44' y='65' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#2b8fb3'/>
  <!-- exhaust -->
  <path d='M58 70 L74 74' stroke='#c9d6e8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- fork -->
  <line x1='72' y1='58' x2='77' y2='70' stroke='#9fb4cc' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- handlebar -->
  <line x1='66' y1='52' x2='74' y2='50' stroke='#9fb4cc' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='48' r='5' fill='#fff59a'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <!-- light beam -->
  <path d='M77 48 L92 40 L92 56 Z' fill='#fff59a' opacity='0.35'/>
</svg>
